definition: the main room in a house where people relax and watch television
exampleSentence: We watch TV in the living room.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi xem ti vi trong phòng khách.

definition: a room in a house or hotel where you eat meals
exampleSentence: The dining room has a big table.
exampleTranslation: Phòng ăn có một cái bàn lớn.

definition: a room for sleeping in
exampleSentence: My bedroom is on the second floor.
exampleTranslation: Phòng ngủ của tôi ở tầng hai.

definition: a bedroom for visitors to use
exampleSentence: You can sleep in the guest room.
exampleTranslation: Bạn có thể ngủ ở phòng dành cho khách.

definition: a part of a building with its own walls, floor and ceiling
exampleSentence: This room is very small.
exampleTranslation: Căn phòng này rất nhỏ.

definition: the area just inside the front door of a house
exampleSentence: We hung our coats in the hall.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi treo áo khoác ở sảnh.

definition: a long narrow passage in a building with doors along it
exampleSentence: The classrooms are along the corridor.
exampleTranslation: Các lớp học nằm dọc theo hành lang.

definition: a building for keeping a car in, usually next to a house
exampleSentence: I put the car in the garage.
exampleTranslation: Tôi để xe ô tô vào nhà để xe.

definition: a space or room just below the roof of a house
exampleSentence: We keep old boxes in the attic.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi để những cái hộp cũ trên gác mái.

definition: a room or area in a building below ground level
exampleSentence: The basement is cold and dark.
exampleTranslation: Tầng hầm vừa lạnh vừa tối.

definition: a room under a house, often used for storing things
exampleSentence: We keep wine in the cellar.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi cất rượu vang dưới hầm.

definition: the floor of a building that is at ground level
exampleSentence: The kitchen is on the ground floor.
exampleTranslation: Nhà bếp ở tầng trệt.

definition: the flat surface that you stand on inside a building
exampleSentence: The cat is sleeping on the floor.
exampleTranslation: Con mèo đang ngủ trên sàn nhà.

definition: a set of stairs inside a building
exampleSentence: The staircase goes up to the bedrooms.
exampleTranslation: Cầu thang dẫn lên các phòng ngủ.

definition: a set of steps for going from one level of a building to another
exampleSentence: I ran up the stairs.
exampleTranslation: Tôi chạy lên cầu thang.

definition: a flat piece of wood or stone you step on to go up or down
exampleSentence: I sat on the step in front of the house.
exampleTranslation: Tôi ngồi trên bậc thềm trước nhà.

definition: a machine that carries people up and down in a tall building
exampleSentence: We took the lift to the tenth floor.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi đi thang máy lên tầng mười.

definition: a machine that takes people from one level of a building to another
exampleSentence: The elevator is broken again.
exampleTranslation: Thang máy lại bị hỏng rồi.

definition: on or towards an upper floor of a building
exampleSentence: I went upstairs and had a shower.
exampleTranslation: Tôi lên lầu và đi tắm.

definition: on or towards a lower floor of a building
exampleSentence: Please come downstairs for dinner.
exampleTranslation: Xuống tầng dưới ăn tối nhé.

definition: a door or gate that you go through to enter a place
exampleSentence: I will wait for you at the main entrance.
exampleTranslation: Tôi sẽ đợi bạn ở lối vào chính.

definition: the flat piece that you open to go into a room, building or car
exampleSentence: Please close the door.
exampleTranslation: Làm ơn đóng cửa lại.

definition: an opening in a wall, filled with glass, that lets in light
exampleSentence: Can you open the window?
exampleTranslation: Bạn mở cửa sổ giúp tôi được không?

definition: one of the sides of a room or building
exampleSentence: There are pictures on the wall.
exampleTranslation: Có mấy bức tranh trên tường.

definition: the inner surface at the top of a room
exampleSentence: The ceiling is very high.
exampleTranslation: Trần nhà rất cao.

definition: the structure that covers the top of a building
exampleSentence: The cat is on the roof.
exampleTranslation: Con mèo đang ở trên mái nhà.

definition: a pipe that lets smoke from a fire go out of a building
exampleSentence: Smoke is coming out of the chimney.
exampleTranslation: Khói đang bốc ra từ ống khói.

definition: a place in the wall of a room where you can make a fire
exampleSentence: We sat by the fireplace.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi ngồi cạnh lò sưởi.

definition: a button by a door that makes a sound when you push it
exampleSentence: Someone is ringing the doorbell.
exampleTranslation: Có người đang bấm chuông cửa.

definition: a round handle that you turn to open a door
translation: tay nắm cửa, nắm đấm cửa
exampleSentence: I turned the doorknob and went in.
exampleTranslation: Tôi xoay tay nắm cửa rồi đi vào.

definition: a hole in a door, or a box outside a house, where letters are delivered
exampleSentence: There is a letter in the letterbox.
exampleTranslation: Có một lá thư trong hộp thư.

definition: a piece of hanging cloth that you pull across a window
exampleSentence: Please close the curtains.
exampleTranslation: Làm ơn kéo rèm lại.

definition: a covering that you roll up and down to cover a window
exampleSentence: Pull down the blind, the sun is bright.
exampleTranslation: Kéo rèm xuống đi, nắng chói quá.

definition: a cover on the outside of a window that you close to keep out light
exampleSentence: We close the shutters at night.
exampleTranslation: Ban đêm chúng tôi đóng cửa chớp lại.

definition: paper that you stick on the walls of a room to decorate it
exampleSentence: The wallpaper in my room is blue.
exampleTranslation: Giấy dán tường trong phòng tôi màu xanh.

definition: a flat square piece of baked clay used to cover walls and floors
exampleSentence: The kitchen floor has white tiles.
exampleTranslation: Sàn bếp lát gạch trắng.

definition: a metal container fixed to a wall that gives heat to a room
exampleSentence: The radiator is on, so the room is warm.
exampleTranslation: Lò sưởi đang bật nên căn phòng rất ấm.

definition: a system that makes the air in a room cooler
exampleSentence: The room has air conditioning.
exampleTranslation: Phòng này có điều hòa.

definition: heavy woven material for covering floors
exampleSentence: We have a green carpet in the living room.
exampleTranslation: Phòng khách nhà chúng tôi trải thảm màu xanh lá.

definition: a small piece of thick material that covers part of a floor
exampleSentence: The dog is lying on the rug.
exampleTranslation: Con chó đang nằm trên tấm thảm.

definition: an area of land next to a house with flowers, grass and plants
exampleSentence: The children are playing in the garden.
exampleTranslation: Bọn trẻ đang chơi trong vườn.

definition: the area around a house, usually covered with grass
exampleSentence: Our dog sleeps in the yard.
exampleTranslation: Con chó nhà tôi ngủ ngoài sân.

definition: an area of short grass in a garden or park
exampleSentence: I mow the lawn every week.
exampleTranslation: Tuần nào tôi cũng cắt cỏ ngoài vườn.

definition: a platform attached to the outside wall of a building above the ground
exampleSentence: Our flat has a small balcony.
exampleTranslation: Căn hộ của chúng tôi có một ban công nhỏ.

definition: a flat outdoor area next to a building where you can sit
exampleSentence: We had lunch on the terrace.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi ăn trưa ngoài sân hiên.

definition: an entrance with a roof outside the front door of a house
exampleSentence: We sat on the porch.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi ngồi ngoài hiên nhà.

definition: the part of a fence or outside wall that you open to go in or out
exampleSentence: Please close the gate.
exampleTranslation: Làm ơn đóng cổng lại.

definition: a structure of wood or metal around a piece of land
exampleSentence: There is a high fence around the garden.
exampleTranslation: Có hàng rào cao quanh khu vườn.

definition: a small building, often made of wood, used for storing things
translation: nhà kho nhỏ, kho chứa đồ
exampleSentence: The tools are in the shed.
exampleTranslation: Dụng cụ ở trong nhà kho.

definition: a structure filled with water for people to swim in
exampleSentence: The hotel has a big swimming pool.
exampleTranslation: Khách sạn có một hồ bơi lớn.

definition: a building that someone lives in, usually for one family
exampleSentence: They live in a big house.
exampleTranslation: Họ sống trong một ngôi nhà lớn.

definition: a set of rooms on one floor of a large building where someone lives
translation: căn hộ, căn hộ chung cư
exampleSentence: We live in a small apartment.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi sống trong một căn hộ nhỏ.

definition: a set of rooms for living in, on one floor of a larger building
exampleSentence: They have a flat in London.
exampleTranslation: Họ có một căn hộ ở Luân Đôn.

definition: a big house in the country, or a house you rent on holiday
exampleSentence: We rented a villa near the beach.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi thuê một biệt thự gần bãi biển.

definition: a small house in the country
translation: ngôi nhà nhỏ ở vùng quê
exampleSentence: They live in a cottage by the lake.
exampleTranslation: Họ sống trong một ngôi nhà nhỏ bên hồ.

definition: large objects such as chairs, tables and beds
exampleSentence: We need new furniture for the living room.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi cần đồ nội thất mới cho phòng khách.

definition: a comfortable seat with arms and a back for two or three people
exampleSentence: We sat on the sofa and watched TV.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi ngồi trên ghế sofa xem ti vi.

definition: a comfortable chair with sides for resting your arms
exampleSentence: There is an old armchair by the window.
exampleTranslation: Có một chiếc ghế bành cũ cạnh cửa sổ.

definition: a sofa that folds out into a bed
translation: sofa giường, ghế sofa kéo thành giường
exampleSentence: You can sleep on the sofa bed.
exampleTranslation: Bạn có thể ngủ trên sofa giường.

definition: a piece of furniture for one person to sit on
exampleSentence: Please sit on this chair.
exampleTranslation: Mời bạn ngồi vào chiếc ghế này.

definition: a seat with three or four legs but no back or arms
exampleSentence: I sat on a stool at the bar.
exampleTranslation: Tôi ngồi trên ghế đẩu ở quầy bar.

definition: a long seat for two or more people, especially outdoors
exampleSentence: We sat on a bench in the park.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi ngồi trên ghế dài trong công viên.

definition: a piece of furniture with a flat top and legs
exampleSentence: Put the plates on the table.
exampleTranslation: Đặt những cái đĩa lên bàn.

definition: a low table for cups, newspapers and magazines
exampleSentence: The remote control is on the coffee table.
exampleTranslation: Điều khiển ti vi ở trên bàn trà.

definition: a table that you sit at to write and work
exampleSentence: My desk is next to the window.
exampleTranslation: Bàn làm việc của tôi ở cạnh cửa sổ.

definition: a table with a mirror that you use for doing your hair or make-up
exampleSentence: There are perfumes on the dressing table.
exampleTranslation: Có mấy lọ nước hoa trên bàn trang điểm.

definition: a piece of furniture with shelves for books
exampleSentence: The bookcase is full of old books.
exampleTranslation: Tủ sách chứa đầy sách cũ.

definition: a shelf that you keep books on
exampleSentence: I put the dictionary back on the bookshelf.
exampleTranslation: Tôi để cuốn từ điển lại lên kệ sách.

definition: a piece of furniture with drawers for keeping clothes in
exampleSentence: I keep my T-shirts in the chest of drawers.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cất áo phông trong tủ ngăn kéo.

definition: a tall cupboard that you hang clothes in
exampleSentence: Hang your coat in the wardrobe.
exampleTranslation: Hãy treo áo khoác vào tủ quần áo.

definition: a piece of furniture that you sleep on
exampleSentence: The bed is next to the window.
exampleTranslation: Giường ở cạnh cửa sổ.

definition: a bed for two people to sleep in
exampleSentence: The room has a double bed.
exampleTranslation: Phòng có một giường đôi.

definition: one of two beds fixed together, one above the other
exampleSentence: The children sleep in a bunk bed.
exampleTranslation: Bọn trẻ ngủ trên giường tầng.

definition: the soft part of a bed that you lie on
exampleSentence: This mattress is very comfortable.
exampleTranslation: Chiếc nệm này rất thoải mái.

definition: a soft cloth bag that you put your head on in bed
exampleSentence: I need another pillow.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cần thêm một cái gối.

definition: a soft cloth bag that you put on a chair or the floor
exampleSentence: There are red cushions on the sofa.
exampleTranslation: Có mấy chiếc gối tựa màu đỏ trên ghế sofa.

definition: a large piece of thin cloth that you put on a bed
exampleSentence: I changed the sheets on my bed.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đã thay ga trải giường.

definition: a thick soft cover filled with feathers or similar material for a bed
exampleSentence: It is cold, so I need a duvet.
exampleTranslation: Trời lạnh nên tôi cần một cái chăn bông.
